outcome: Prevalence of COVID-19 in pregnant women
Clinical outcomes of COVID-19 in pregnant women
cohort: Pregnant women with COVID-19 admitted to Charlotte Maxeke Johannesburg Academic Hospital between March 6 and August 30, 2020
finding: The study found a higher COVID-19-related mortality rate in their cohort compared to international data, likely due to differences in background maternal mortality rates and access to care.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was the most common mode of delivery, but no women underwent caesarean section for indications related to COVID-19.
